body:
IGN: LokighTheJiff
Reason: Pls be nice in chat
Reason why i should be unbanned:
Heres the thing, i know my behavior was not acceptable i get that but i dont wanna miss out on the fun stuff thats gonna be happening on Avicus on New Years Eve and Day, i even planned on playing with everyone w/ me being on TS, so i was hoping if i could have my ban moved to January 4 (11pm Philippine Time) to January 6 (11pm Philippine Time) since i will be back to school starting on January 5 and i have the rescheduled last day of exams on that day since our original last day of exams on the 3rd quarter got cancelled due to suspension of class due to heavy rains and flood

I hope you could consider this, i will be gladly accepting a ban on those days
